statements.text: IT Acceptable Use Policy covers every computer, phone, tablet and network service provided by the organisation, and any personal device that is used to reach organisational systems.

Passwords must be at least twelve characters and may not be reused across systems.

Lost or stolen devices, suspected phishing messages and any unexpected access to files must be reported to the service desk immediately.
